name: COMP_035
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (47%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Suspect frozen-section quality, unseparated InSitu (38%) and Normal (15%), and deferred margins [F7] warrant permanent sections or recut.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 47%, InSitu 38%, Normal 15%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Split between Benign and InSitu |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign, InSitu (90% coverage, ECE 5%) | Cannot exclude InSitu or Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.22 reliability (flagged); 74th OOD percentile (AUROC 0.70) [F6] | Suspect input; reduced read confidence |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 1/5 Benign (20%); 4/5 Normal (top 90% similarity) [F5] | Neighbors mostly Normal, not Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-1.251), but 0/20 AI spot check is unreliable [F2] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 9) · context · Below-typical score (-0.177, +0.638); descriptive context only (8/20 spot check) [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.419) supports non-invasive read (20/20 spot check) [F4] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 4, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Elevated score (-0.324); differs from Normal neighbor BACH_0236 (12/20) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); top driver `normal_lobules` (0/20 spot check) is unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- In situ carcinoma (38% probability) is present in regions 4, 5, 6 or visible only on deeper levels.
- Frozen-section artifact (reliability 0.22, 74th OOD percentile) masks atypia or margin involvement in region 9 (recut drafted).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 8**: Highest risk (0.416 in 9) and inferior/medial margin scores (100%, 91%); defer margin.
2. **Regions 4, 5, 6**: Highest duct-confined atypia scores (1.07–1.29); rule out InSitu (38%) and order deeper levels.
3. **Regions 7, 10, 11**: Mild risk (0.009–0.086) with benign stroma/fat; check quality for drafted recut H&E.
